title: Paying for the learning curve.
summary: More than 35,000 associate hours on AI in 2026.

spec.problem: Billable-hour targets penalized the time lawyers needed to learn and test AI tools.
spec.changed: Up to 100 hours of AI training and experimentation per lawyer now count toward annual billable targets.
spec.systems: Firm AI tools; not itemized in the reporting.
spec.result: **More than 35,000 associate hours on AI in 2026** across 1,000+ eligible lawyers. Reuters, October 2026.

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
